fields.acc_emp: QCEW NAICS 721 private employment, mean of 12 months 2025Q2-2026Q1
fields.acc_wages: QCEW NAICS 721 total wages USD, sum of 4 quarters
fields.leis_hosp_emp: QCEW supersector 1026 leisure & hospitality employment (4q mean)
fields.priv_emp: QCEW total private employment (industry 10, own 5, 4q mean)
fields.seasonality_q: employment index by calendar quarter [Q1,Q2,Q3,Q4], 1.0 = 4q mean (source in season_src: 721 or 1026)
fields.hot_receipts_12m: Texas only: local hotel occupancy tax revenue FY2025 (Ch.351 city + Ch.352 county), USD, cities assigned to modal county
fields.str_registered: registered STR supply: TX = active state hotel-tax permits with NAICS 531110/531311 (owner-registered STRs; platform-collected STRs not included); Denver = STR licences
fields.str_city_registry: city registry counts inside the county (Austin STR Locations)
fields.wiki_views_12m: English Wikipedia user pageviews of county-seat article(s), Nov 2025-Oct 2026
fields.wiki_season_idx: calendar-month index (Jan..Dec) of seat-article views over 24 months, 1.0 = mean
fields.wiki_peak_months: calendar months with index >= 1.15 (else the single max month)
